summary: End-to-end digital transformation for an artisan jewelry brand: from manual Instagram management to an autonomous web ecosystem with an editorial catalog and a custom-built inventory admin panel. Real-time stock sync, no developer dependency.
galleryDescription: Editorial minimalist design that lets the warmth of bronze, copper, and alpaca metals take center stage — generous whitespace, clean grids, and frictionless mobile filtering. Paired with a private React SPA that turns inventory management into a matter of a few clicks.

processSteps.title: Diagnose the bottleneck
processSteps.description: Before this project, Gypsy ran entirely through Instagram DMs. Customers had no centralized place to check availability or pricing; every inquiry was manual. The goal: replace that friction with a real-time, self-managed catalog.

processSteps.title: Design the architecture
processSteps.description: Decoupled but synchronized: a Vanilla JS public catalog for instant mobile performance and clean SEO, connected via a REST API to a React + Vite admin SPA that pushes every update live to the storefront.

processSteps.title: Build the CMS
processSteps.description: Node.js + Express serverless functions on Vercel, PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM for typed migrations, and Vercel Blob for high-resolution jewelry photography — all wired to a private admin panel where creating, editing, or retiring a product takes seconds.

processSteps.title: Ship autonomy
processSteps.description: The owner of Gypsy went from answering manual DMs to managing their own digital catalog independently — no technical knowledge required. The catalog elevated the perceived value of artisan pieces with a fast, official channel that amplifies Instagram traffic.
